description: This file defines a Catalyst controller for managing purchase lists within a project. It includes actions for listing, editing, creating, updating, and deleting purchase lists, as well as handling related entities like items and ingredients.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::PurchaseList
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing purchase lists, including actions for listing, editing, creating, updating, and deleting purchase lists, as well as handling related items and ingredients.

methods.name: submenu
methods.description: Sets up submenu items for navigation within the purchase list section.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays a list of purchase lists with associated metadata and URLs.

methods.name: preorder
methods.description: Prepares and displays a preorder list for the project.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures a purchase list by ID and sets it in the stash for further actions.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares data for editing a specific purchase list, including preorders, sections, and units.

methods.name: remove_ingredient
methods.description: Removes an ingredient from a purchase list and redirects back to the edit page.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new purchase list with a specified date.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the name of a purchase list, with validation to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects to the index action of the purchase list controller.
